firstAction: Create statutory-report template and assign an editor.
consequence: The report can be structurally non-compliant even if a standalone ESG report exists.

readinessTest: Applicable ESRS version and requirement mapping are approved.
firstAction: Issue a dated standard-version determination (from CSRD-S-012).
consequence: The wrong standard version causes extensive rework and assurance findings.

readinessTest: Double-materiality process is documented, performed, approved and current.
firstAction: Complete the process and record governance decisions.
consequence: Material disclosure scope may be unsupported.

readinessTest: Governance and disclosure ownership are named.
firstAction: Baseline existing records, then fill ownership gaps.
consequence: Work remains unowned and evidence cannot be assured.
The statutory sustainability package may be incomplete.

readinessTest: Assurance provider, scope, controls and evidence runway exist.
firstAction: Start provider appointment and evidence-control mapping.
consequence: An assurance bottleneck can delay or qualify the report.

readinessTest: Worker consultation process is applicable and completed.
Electronic output is configured and tested.
firstAction: Create and validate a sample output.

readinessTest: Country-specific approval, filing, language and publication calendar is loaded.
existingEvidenceToCredit: Country calendar and prior filing workflow
firstAction: Load pilot-country rules and create dated tasks.
consequence: A correct report may still be filed late or incorrectly.

readinessTest: National transition exemption is supported by a current legal source.
firstAction: Obtain country-law review before stopping work.
consequence: False all-clear or unnecessary reporting expenditure.

readinessTest: All exemption conditions remain complete and current.
existingEvidenceToCredit: Parent report, public link, assurance and inclusion evidence
consequence: The subsidiary may unexpectedly need its own report.

readinessTest: Third-country standard and EU gateway publication plan are ready.
existingEvidenceToCredit: Group reporting plan and gateway calendar
firstAction: Track N-ESRS development and assign gateway owners.
consequence: The future reporting programme starts too late.

readinessTest: Customer request is mapped to purpose, cap and voluntary response decision.
firstAction: Map items and approve the response strategy.
consequence: The supplier may over-disclose, under-respond or damage the relationship.

readinessTest: Above-cap request contains required labelling and rights notice.
Missing value-chain information explanation and improvement plan exist.
firstAction: Document efforts, reasons and future plan.

readinessTest: Evidence registry records owner, pointer, freshness and acceptance.
firstAction: Create registry entries without forcing file migration.
consequence: Assurance becomes a fire drill and posture is unsupported.
